summary: 32-year-old archery hunter dislocated his knee in a fall ~3 miles south of Pearl Lake; phoned his mother in North Routt, who walked into the North Routt Fire station ~12:45 p.m.; rescued by RCSAR, North Routt Fire, and Basic Air Medical
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue; North Routt Fire; Basic Air Medical
notes: Monday-afternoon incident per the Denver Post 2024-10-03 story mirrored at JHB News (parent-opened); previously parked as the dateless Pearl Lake lead.
